story.region: A rented flat in Chicago, 1:14 AM
story.title: It Drops At 1:14

narrator.persona: a freelance graphic designer speaking six months after her roommate vanished

sentences.text: Soft scratching right above my pillow. Exactly at one-fourteen every single night.
The police found my roommate's phone on the kitchen floor, completely untouched.
I crept out of bed and tiptoed down the creaking wooden stairs with my flashlight.
The scraping noise stopped, replaced by a wet, heavy breathing sound from the dark ceiling.
I forced myself to tilt my head straight up and shine the beam into the corner.
Two glowing red eyes stared down at me from a pale, elongated face pressed against the plaster.
Would you still be living here if your front door was left unlocked from the inside?
